title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: scop R package comprehensive single-cell spatial omics analysis, providing modular workflows analyzing, integrating, visualizing, interactively exploring single-cell spatial omics data. Documentation: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/ Function reference examples: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/ Changelog: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/news/index.html Integrated quality control methods single-cell RNA-seq single-cell ATAC-seq, including cell cycle analysis: Seurat gene-set scoring, scran::cyclone, tricycle discrete continuous cell cycle state estimation, doublet detection methods (scDblFinder, scds, Scrublet, DoubletDetection) ambient RNA decontamination via decontX. Pipelines embedded multiple methods normalization, highly variable feature selection, feature reduction (PCA, ICA, NMF, MDS, GLMPCA, UMAP, TriMap, LargeVis, PaCMAP, PHATE, DM, FR), cell population identification, including optional scran-based deconvolution normalization HVF modeling. Pipelines embedded multiple integration methods scRNA-seq data, including Uncorrected, Seurat CCA/RPCA workflows, scVI, MNN, fastMNN, Harmony, Scanorama, BBKNN, CSS, Coralysis, LIGER, Conos, ComBat. Pipelines embedded RNA + ATAC multimodal integration methods, including Seurat v5 integration, WNN-based integration, GLUE, MultiMAP, cross-modality co-embedding workflows. Multiple methods automatic annotation single-cell data (CellTypist, SciBet, SingleR, Scmap, KNNPredict), significance-based hierarchical clustering CHOIR, methods projection single-cell datasets (CSSMap, PCAMap, SeuratMap, SymphonyMap). Bulk transcriptomics cellular composition workflows, including differential expression via DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom, dream, deconvolution via MuSiC, BisqueRNA, BayesPrism, Cell2location, cell-type-specific differential expression via TOAST, composition analysis Milo, propeller, scCODA, permutation-based tests, scProportionTest. Differential expression perturbation analysis: identification differential features, expressed marker identification, rare-cell population detection RareQ, phenotype-associated cell selection Scissor, feature-weight phenotype scoring FWP, network comparison scTenifoldNet, -silico perturbation analysis scTenifoldKnk. Enrichment, functional scoring: -representation analysis, GSEA analysis, GSVA, AUCell, UCell, metabolic pathway activity inference via scMetabolism, metabolic flux estimation via scFEA. Transcription factor activity analysis via DoRothEA, SCENIC/SCENIC+, GRNBoost2, GENIE3, cisTarget, dynamic enrichment analysis. CNV analysis scRNA-seq copykat, infercnv, SCEVAN, fastCNV, plus tumor microenvironment scoring via ESTIMATE. Cellular potency: CytoTRACE 2 FitDevo predicting cellular differentiation potential. RNA velocity: RNA velocity, Cell2fate, PAGA, Palantir, CellRank, WOT. Trajectory inference: Slingshot, Monocle2, Monocle3, developmental direction inference VECTOR, identification dynamic features. Cell-cell communication: CellChat, spatially constrained SpatialCellChat, CellphoneDB, NicheNet, MultiNicheNet, LIANA. Cellular composition analysis: differential abundance proportion testing across conditions. Spatial analysis: modular domain (Banksy, BayesSpace, PRECAST), feature, neighborhood, integration, deconvolution (SPOTlight, SpaNorm, CARDspa), spot QC (SpotSweeper), SpatialCellChat communication workflows; native spatial networks cell-boundary visualization; lightweight bridge Giotto without wrapping full framework. High-quality data visualization methods. Fast deployment single-cell data SCExplorer, shiny app provides interactive visualization interface.

title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: scop package developed based SCP package, following major improvements: Compatibility: full support Seurat v5. Stability: compatibility repairs automated package checks. Optional backends require separate runtime validation; successful package check establish every backend executed. Usability: Python environment setup workflow improved, support conda-compatible managers including conda, mamba, micromamba; standardized console messages via thisutils::log_message consistent, readable function outputs. Performance: new parallel framework developed based thisutils::parallelize_fun, providing consistent experience across Linux, macOS, Windows. Functionality: analysis methods added.

text: analysis based subsetted version mouse pancreas data.
code: library(scop) data(pancreas_sub) print(pancreas_sub) #> An object of class Seurat  #> 47994 features across 1000 samples within 3 assays  #> Active assay: RNA (15998 features, 0 variable features) #>  1 layer present: counts #>  2 other assays present: spliced, unspliced pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub) print(pancreas_sub) #>  An object of class Seurat  #>  47994 features across 1000 samples within 3 assays  #>  Active assay: RNA (15998 features, 2000 variable features) #>   3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data #>   2 other assays present: spliced, unspliced #>   5 dimensional reductions calculated: Standardpca, StandardpcaUMAP2D, StandardpcaUMAP3D, StandardUMAP2D, StandardUMAP3D CellDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   group.by = c("CellType", "SubCellType"),   reduction = "UMAP",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) CellDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   group.by = "SubCellType",   stat.by = "Phase",   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) FeatureDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   features = c("Sox9", "Neurog3", "Fev", "Rbp4"),   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) FeatureDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   features = c("Ins1", "Gcg", "Sst", "Ghrl"),   compare_features = TRUE,   label = TRUE,   label_insitu = TRUE,   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) ht <- GroupHeatmap(   pancreas_sub,   features = c(     "Sox9", "Anxa2", # Ductal     "Neurog3", "Hes6", # EPs     "Fev", "Neurod1", # Pre-endocrine     "Rbp4", "Pyy", # Endocrine     "Ins1", "Gcg", "Sst", "Ghrl" # Beta, Alpha, Delta, Epsilon   ),   group.by = c("CellType", "SubCellType"),   heatmap_palette = "Spectral",   cell_annotation = c("Phase", "G2M_score", "Cdh2"),   cell_annotation_palette = c("Dark2", "Chinese", "Chinese"),   show_row_names = TRUE,   nlabel = 0,   row_names_side = "left",   add_dot = TRUE,   add_reticle = TRUE,   width = 2.2,   height = 2.5 ) print(ht$plot)

title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: example holds celseq2 cells bundled human pancreas object query uses technologies reference. inputs shared cells use species gene identifiers. Changing gene name capitalization cross-species ortholog mapping.  query colours supplied held-labels, predictions. Projection neighbour-weighted placement reference UMAP; new joint embedding evidence successful batch correction.
code: data(panc8_sub) query_ids <- colnames(panc8_sub)[panc8_sub$tech == "celseq2"] reference_ids <- setdiff(colnames(panc8_sub), query_ids) stopifnot(length(intersect(query_ids, reference_ids)) == 0,           length(query_ids) + length(reference_ids) == ncol(panc8_sub)) annotation_query <- RunStandardWorkflow(   panc8_sub[, query_ids], assay = "RNA", seed = 11, cores = 1,   verbose = FALSE ) annotation_reference <- RunStandardWorkflow(   panc8_sub[, reference_ids], assay = "RNA", seed = 11, cores = 1,   verbose = FALSE ) shared_features <- intersect(SeuratObject::VariableFeatures(annotation_query),                              SeuratObject::VariableFeatures(annotation_reference)) stopifnot(length(shared_features) > 30) label_colors <- stats::setNames(   grDevices::hcl.colors(length(unique(annotation_reference$celltype)), "Dark 3"),   sort(unique(as.character(annotation_reference$celltype))) ) annotation_query <- RunKNNMap(   srt_query = annotation_query,   srt_ref = annotation_reference,   features = shared_features,   ref_umap = DefaultReduction(annotation_reference, pattern = "UMAP"),   projection_method = "knn" ) ProjectionPlot(   srt_query = annotation_query,   srt_ref = annotation_reference,   query_group = "celltype",   ref_group = "celltype",   query_param = list(palcolor = label_colors, cells.highlight = TRUE),   ref_param = list(palcolor = label_colors, xlab = "UMAP_1", ylab = "UMAP_2") )

code: ReadATACData(   object,   ranges = NULL,   metadata = NULL,   peaks.file = NULL,   barcodes.file = NULL,   cell.names = NULL,   sample = NULL,   genome = NULL,   annotation = NULL,   fragments = NULL,   fragment.cells = NULL,   assay = "peaks",   project = "ATAC",   verbose = TRUE )

title: Read raw ATAC counts into a ChromatinAssay — ReadATACData
text: object numeric sparse peak--cell matrix, local 10x ATAC/ARC H5 path, local Matrix Market path. Separate matrices different peak universes must recounted combining; function never fills unmeasured peaks zeros. supported Signac constructor requires least two cells two peaks. ranges GRanges 1-based closed coordinates, required sparse matrix. Named ranges aligned matrix row names; unnamed ranges explicitly use matrix row order. Duplicate genomic intervals rejected. metadata Optional data frame unique row names matching input matrix cell IDs exactly. Rows reordered ID, never position. Supplied nCount_<assay>/nFeature_<assay> columns must agree raw matrix; conflicting QC metadata rejected. peaks.file, barcodes.file Three-column peaks BED one-column barcode paths, required object Matrix Market path. Gzip compression supported. Without companion files path read H5, importing explicitly declared Peaks modality standard feature table; H5 requires optional hdf5r. title: Run CytoTRACE 2 — RunCytoTRACE
text: Predicts cellular developmental potential single-cell RNA-seq data using CytoTRACE 2 algorithm (Kang et al., 2025). default, function uses official CytoTRACE2 R package. Set backend = "cpp" use package R/C++ implementation. algorithm consists five stages: Preprocessing: Gene orthology mapping, feature selection, ranking, log2-CPM transformation. GSBN Ensemble Prediction: 19 pre-trained Gene Set Binary Network models predict continuous developmental potency score (0-1) discrete potency category. Diffusion Smoothing: Markov random-walk--restart cell-cell similarity graph smooths raw scores. Binning: Within potency category, cells ranked linearly scaled corresponding segments unit interval. Adaptive kNN Smoothing: PCA-based nearest-neighbor consensus refinement final scores.

"knn" selected, function directly find nearest neighbors using distance metric. nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. k number nearest neighbors find cell query object. distance_metric distance metric use calculating pairwise distances cells. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. paste0("GENE", seq_len(150)) make_counts <- function(n, prefix) {   mu <- matrix(8, 150, n)   mu[1:30, seq_len(n / 2)] <- 24   mu[31:60, (n / 2 + 1):n] <- 24   Matrix::Matrix(matrix(rnbinom(length(mu), mu = mu, size = 10), 150,     dimnames = list(genes, paste0(prefix, seq_len(n)))   ), sparse = TRUE) } reference <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(make_counts(60, "ref")) reference$label <- rep(c("classA", "classB"), each = 30) reference <- Seurat::NormalizeData(reference, verbose = FALSE) reference <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(reference, nfeatures = 150, verbose = FALSE) reference <- Seurat::ScaleData(reference, features = genes, verbose = FALSE) reference <- Seurat::RunPCA(reference, features = genes, npcs = 10, verbose = FALSE) activity <- make_counts(40, "query") peaks <- Matrix::Matrix(matrix(rpois(200 * 40, 4), 200,   dimnames = list(paste0(     "chr1-", seq(1, by = 200, length.out = 200), "-",     seq(100, by = 200, length.out = 200)   ), colnames(activity)) ), sparse = TRUE) query <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(   Signac::CreateChromatinAssay(counts = peaks),   assay = "peaks" ) query[["ACTIVITY"]] <- SeuratObject::CreateAssayObject(counts = activity) query <- Seurat::NormalizeData(query, assay = "ACTIVITY", verbose = FALSE) query <- Signac::RunTFIDF(query, assay = "peaks", verbose = FALSE) query <- Signac::FindTopFeatures(query, assay = "peaks", min.cutoff = "q0", verbose = FALSE) query <- Signac::RunSVD(query, assay = "peaks", n = 10, verbose = FALSE) query <- code: if (interactive()) {   PrepareEnv()   check_python("scvelo")   scv <- import("scvelo")   adata <- scv$datasets$pancreas()   pancreas <- adata_to_srt(adata)   set.seed(98)   cells <- sample(colnames(pancreas), size = 1000)   pancreas_sub <- pancreas[, cells]   pancreas_sub <- pancreas_sub[Matrix::rowSums(     GetAssayData5(       pancreas_sub,       layer = "counts"     )   ) > 0, ]   pancreas_sub[["CellType"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters_coarse"]]   pancreas_sub[["SubCellType"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters"]]   pancreas_sub[["clusters_coarse"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters"]] <- NULL   pancreas_sub[["Phase"]] <- ifelse(     pancreas_sub$S_score > pancreas_sub$G2M_score,     "S",     "G2M"   )   pancreas_sub[["Phase"]][apply(     pancreas_sub[[]][, c("S_score", "G2M_score")],     1,     max   ) < 0, ] <- "G1"   pancreas_sub[["Phase", drop = TRUE]] <- factor(     pancreas_sub[["Phase", drop = TRUE]],     levels = c("G1", "S", "G2M")   )   pancreas_sub$CellType <- gsub("_", "-", pancreas_sub$CellType)   pancreas_sub$CellType <- gsub(" ", "-", pancreas_sub$CellType)   pancreas_sub$SubCellType <- gsub("_", "-", pancreas_sub$SubCellType)   pancreas_sub$SubCellType <- gsub(" ", "-", pancreas_sub$SubCellType)   pancreas_sub@reductions$X_pca <- NULL   pancreas_sub@reductions$X_umap <- NULL   use_data <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("usethis", "use_data")   use_data(     pancreas_sub,     compress = "xz",     overwrite = TRUE   ) }

title: scop 0.9.1
text: Internal preprocessing integration workflows now use scop’s Seurat-compatible entry points, enabling validated native acceleration normalization, variable-feature selection, scaling, PCA, neighbor search retaining transparent Seurat fallback unsupported paths. native SCTransform(vst.flavor = "v2") path now supports validated numeric factor vars..regress designs latent.data; unsupported regression designs continue delegate Seurat. native PCA auto path accepts smaller stable trailing eigengaps numerical neighborhood-parity validation, allowing datasets use accelerated implementation. Added CellScoringPlot() paired group/score UMAPs, score distributions, threshold proportions, complete multi-program layouts CellScoring() results. CellRank + Palantir fate workflow now supports MAGIC layers, explicit Schur sizes terminal-state validation, normalized fate/driver/transition payloads, CellRank GAM trend modules, module enrichment, result-CellRankPlot() views. Added RunCOMMOT() COMMOTPlot() official COMMOT spatial communication isolated Python subprocess raw-coordinate provenance optional external H5AD storage. Added RunSpaTalk() SpaTalkPlot() official SpaTalk single-cell spot-reference spatial communication workflows compact unified CCC storage. Added CCCNetworkPlot(plot_type = "spatial"), stored-result slice overlay SpatialCellChat, SpaTalk, COMMOT abundance-scaled group nodes, sender-coloured directed edges, proportion-aware composition pies. RunCNV() backend coverage: copykat, fastCNV, SCEVAN, infercnv, numbat now verified original pipelines real bundled datasets (breast-cancer scRNA-seq, infercnv example, numbat ATC2 example), exact prediction agreement copykat/SCEVAN/numbat Spearman rho = 1.0 fastCNV/infercnv. MERINGUE C++ permutation kernel now traverses weight matrix sparsely (row-major edge list, bit-identical accumulation): nperm = 200 Moran p-values 300 spots drop ~442s ~14s (~30x). Removed wrappers whose upstream dependencies unavailable uncompilable: RunSpatialQM(), RunSemla*() wrappers, BASS/SpatialMNN branches RunSpatialIntegration() (PRECAST unaffected), SPATA2 backend = "r" path RunSpatialGradientFeatures() (C++ backend ; srt_to_spata2()/spata2_to_srt() removed well). RunMERINGUE() gains backend = c("cpp", "r") option; C++ kernels replicate MERINGUE::moranTest()/moranPermutationTest() machine precision (including sample.kind RNG stream). backend = "r" retains original calls honors moran_params. Real-data consistency tests verify wrappers original pipelines (CellChat, SpatialCellChat, LIANA, BayesSpace, MERINGUE, SPOTlight, SpaNorm, SpatialDWLS, RCTD, BANKSY, CARD, SpotSweeper, PRECAST). DorotheaPlot() now follows shared scop plot style: horizontal "bar"/"lollipop" comparison plots, "volcano", "heatmap" via GroupHeatmap(), "dim" (activity vs expression embeddings), "stat" (FeatureStatPlot distributions), "targets" (regulon-target volcano). RunDorothea() examples show FeatureDimPlot() / FeatureStatPlot() TF-activity assay. RunIntegrationBenchmark() compares integration methods scIB-style iLISI/cLISI, ASW, graph connectivity, ARI/NMI scores returns Seurat object. Tables live srt@tools$IntegrationBenchmark printed thisplot::print_colored_table(). IntegrationBenchmarkPlot() draws box (per-cell LISI), heatmap, scatter, UMAP views. LISIPlot() removed; use IntegrationBenchmarkPlot(plot_type = "box"). SCENICPlot() / SCENICPlusPlot(): heatmap_dotplot, eregulon_dim, coverage, network, network_graph, egrn, overlap. "network" draws one hub per TF. Network plots title. Networks use "Chinese" palette = "RdYlBu". Multi-TF legends show top RSS cell type. R-CMD-check now installs presto directly immunogenomics/presto, avoiding dependency-resolution failures caused treating GitHub-package CRAN package. RunCellRank() now disables PETSc explicitly retrying fate probabilities SciPy’s direct solver, preventing CellRank 2.0.7 silently reverting retry GMRES rejecting harmless floating-point negative probabilities (#380). RunCellRank() defaults dependency-free brandts Schur method , standard scop_env longer fails optional petsc4py slepc4py packages absent. Users can still request schur_method = "krylov" packages installed (#380). CellRank stored-result plotting now follows SCOP’s theme_scop, Chinese, Spectral visual contracts; draws transition projections directly saved sparse transition matrix; supports random walks without requiring trend results; facets trend modules; adds module-enrichment dot plots. CellRank enrichment selects database gene-ID column overlaps actual driver background, including three-column GO tables Entrez symbol identifiers. Linux shared-library preloading keeps package-local load_shared_library() seam, dependency-order retries can tested without attempting mock base dyn.load() function SCOP namespace binding. Coordinate-contract validation now covers unified CCC plots SpatialCellChat, COMMOT, SpaTalk without rejecting coordinate-independent SpatialDWLS proportions. Explicit coordinate_space = "legacy_display" analysis preserves historical lowres--hires fallback; current display plotting remains strict selected scale. Spatial coordinate contract v2 now reads full-resolution VisiumV1/VisiumV2 coordinates, restores imagerow/imagecol order Seurat’s standard VisiumV2 loader stores positionally centroid x/y, preserves explicit generic FOV x/y, normalizes explicitly named legacy image row/column coordinates, applies exactly one selected lowres hires display transform. SpatialCoordinates(), -overlay point/pie/network plots, public wrappers gain appended image.scale argument; variadic wrappers keep named-.... Raw SpatialCellChat analysis longer requires available display scale, coordinate-independent producers longer claim coordinate-contract version. Users longer need modify Seurat @scale.factors slots. Coordinate-dependent stored results created older unknown contract must rerun. RunSlingshot() / CellDimPlot(lineages=) longer fail scale$guide == "none" ggplot2 >= 3.5 ggnewscale older 0.5.0. Colour/fill scales now keep character guide, legend overrides go guides(), ggnewscale pinned >= 0.5.2, failed lineage plot longer discards Slingshot result. RunGSEA() / RunEnrichment() longer fail “replacement 0 rows, data N” cached database carries empty version. KEGG REST API dropped Release line /info/<org>, PrepareDB() now resolves KEGG version release-notes page info endpoint report (retrieval-date fallback; HPO hardened way), enrichment writers tolerate missing versions. RunSpaTalk() now reuses stored RunRCTD() weights SpaTalk method 2, records deconvolution source, accepts working installed SpaTalk package even DESCRIPTION lacks GitHub remote metadata. RunLIANA() now preserves field set returned LIANA’s official consensus mode: rank consensus longer gains -NA aggregate/significance placeholders, aggregate consensus longer gains -NA magnitude/specificity placeholders, deterministic ligand-receptor display identifiers completed SCOP/LIANA export. RunCNV() attaches backend packages search path execution lazy data objects (copykat full.anno, fastCNV geneMetadata, numbat gtf_hg38) resolvable backend namespace code; copykat installed GitHub source (navinlabcode/copykat) removed CRAN. RunCNV(numbat) prefers plain seg column seg_label reading joint_post output, segment identifiers polluted (loh) suffix. RunCNV() numbat extraction vectorized (direct index assignment duplicate averaging instead row--row aggregate/strsplit, plus split()-partitioned bin statistics): 300-seg x 2000-cell joint_post extraction drops ~16s ~1.3s (~12x) bit-identical results. visium_mouse_brain_slices_sub rebuilt current SeuratObject bundled VisiumV2 images can subset . RunRCTD() extracts per-spot all_weights spacexr >= 2.2 doublet_mode = "multi" results. RunSpotSweeper() detects upstream SpotSweeper::localVariance breakage SpatialExperiment colData degrades gracefully. RunSpatialIntegration(PRECAST) writes raw coordinates expected CreatePRECASTObject. RunLIANA() recognizes logfc_comb (liana method score columns) interaction score. Exported theme_scop / theme_spatial listed pkgdown reference index; theme_scop alias test compares function equality rather identity installed-package checks pass. DorotheaPlot(plot_type = "volcano") plots every tested TF, caps Wilcoxon underflow y-axis, colors points direction, labels significant TFs. "targets" labels significant genes leader lines longer pile x = 0. CaSpER branch RunCNV() removed: runCaSpER() segfaults deterministically R >= 4.5 (HMM manualSegment, even 50 cells), upstream unmaintained since 2019, Bioconductor dependency set archived. RunCNV() now supports copykat, fastCNV, scevan, infercnv, numbat. RunBenchmark() / BenchmarkPlot() replaced RunSpatialBenchmark() / SpatialBenchmarkPlot(). old names removed. RunCell2fate() examples call RunStandardWorkflow() plot time, uncertainty, module activation, module state. env_requirements() also shows standalone Cell2fate Python 3.9 stack. ListLIANAResources() replaced ListCCCDB(), enumerates ligand-receptor databases prior models across CCC backends unified db/species/status schema. New PrepareCCCDB() prepares CellTalk CellChat databases (TERM2GENE/TERM2NAME, R.cache-backed); CellTalk/CellChat branches removed PrepareDB(). Database listing outputs unified (ListDB() ListCCCDB() return plain data frames; colored console rendering available via thisplot::print_colored_table()). Python-converted object interop: PAGAPlot(), VelocityPlot()/CellDimPlot(velocity=), RunPAGA(use_rna_velocity), RunCellRank(), DE consumers (VolcanoPlot(), DEtestPlot(), RunEnrichment(), RunGSEA(), …), RunScissor() now fall back scanpy/scVelo result slots (paga, rank_genes_groups, velocity_umap, dpt_pseudotime, connectivities) stored adata_to_srt().

title: scop 0.9.0
text: New optional-backend wrappers: RunCHOIR() significance-based hierarchical clustering RunCell2fate() RNA-velocity modeling, pinned backend provenance, strict result validation, metadata writeback, resumable artifacts. Added RunCell2location() official Python cell2location reference-signature learning spatial abundance mapping, manifest-validated resume, signature reuse, Cell2locationPlot() visualizations. Added RunCNV() unified CNV workflow optional copykat, infercnv, SCEVAN, fastCNV backends, standardized srt@tools[["CNV"]] storage, CNVPlot() visualizations; added RunESTIMATE() stromal/immune/tumor-purity scoring EstimateScorePlot() / EstimateGenePlot(). GRN analysis extended: RunSCENICPlus() SCENIC+ multi-omics workflows, plus standalone RunGRNBoost2(), RunGENIE3(), RunCisTarget() modules sharing SCENIC regulon infrastructure. Added RunSpatialCellChat() SpatialCellChat v3 producer cell-, spot-, composition-level communication, raw--micron coordinate contracts schema-v1 provenance; GetCCCObject() SpatialCellChatPlot() provide stored-result access. Spatial analysis framework: added spatial contract schema v1 (SpatialCoordinates(), GetSpatialResult(), GetSpatialGraph()), shared spatial method registry (ListSpatialMethods(), SpatialBackendStatus(), SpatialResultInfo()), strict raw-coordinate defaults, sparse BiocNeighbors-backed graph kernels SmoothClust, spatial-variable-feature, spatial-neighborhood paths. Added RunSpatialBenchmark() SpatialBenchmarkPlot() failure-tolerant comparison stable spatial-domain clustering methods (ARI/NMI/purity, runtime, peak memory); added ClusterTreePlot() multi-resolution clustering trees. Visualization improvements: FeatureStatPlot()/ExpressionStatPlot() gain auto_comparison; GSVAPlot() gains mode = "diff" two-group pathway test; FeatureHeatmap(), DynamicHeatmap(), GroupHeatmap() compact long multi-term annotations; CellCorHeatmap() gains legend.position. Performance: C++ acceleration core Seurat flow — NormalizeData(), FindVariableFeatures(), ScaleData(), PCA neighbor search — marker detection (FindMarkers(), FindAllMarkers(), FindConservedMarkers()); native kernels manifold learning (UMAP, PaCMAP, TriMap, PHATE, DM), trajectory inference (PAGA, SCVELO, VECTOR), Z-score/PLAGE/ssGSEA/AUCell gene-set scoring, spatial-variable-feature statistics, cross-KNN connectivity graphs, integration embeddings. RunMetabolism() now builds gene sets via PrepareDB() default species-aware conversion; PrepareDB() accepts local single-file database sources (MSigDB, CORUM, JASPAR, TRRUST, CellChat, ); RunSCENIC() gained genome parameter hg38/hg19 reference selection. RunSpatialNeighborhood() defaults observed-neighborhood summaries; standard spatial workflow records per-stage requested/completed/skipped/failed state reports partial completion. Renamed standard_scop() RunStandardWorkflow() integration_scop() RunIntegration() (multi-method support via integration_methods); renamed db_scDblFinder(), db_scds(), db_Scrublet(), db_DoubletDetection() RunscDblFinder(), Runscds(), RunScrublet(), RunDoubletDetection(). Old entry points emit deprecation warnings removed version 1.0.0. Spatial analysis, plotting, framework conversion now require explicit image selection multi-image objects; distance-sensitive producers default raw acquisition coordinates (coordinate_space = "legacy_display" remains available). Added visium_human_pancreas_sub, Visium human pancreas spatial example dataset (GSE254829) spatial image data CODA-derived annotations, spatial analysis. Added Xenium package-data import script preparing curated Xenium example resources outside installed package payload.

title: scop 0.8.9
text: RunLIANA() now stores LIANA’s official multi-method consensus rank_aggregate() liana_aggregate() alongside historical method-stacked scop-postprocessed tables. Human mouse defaults use Consensus MouseConsensus ligand-receptor resources, respectively, multiple resources aggregated independently. Added ListLIANAResources(), ListCCCMethods(), CCCResultInfo(), GetCCCResult() resource discovery Seurat-centered CCC result access. RunCCC() now registers seven SCOP CCC producers retaining CellChat, CellPhoneDB, LIANA default core run. Unified CCC plotting separates backends default provides explicit support-count within-method percentile-rank views. Hardened unified CCC plotting access semantics: context filters applied cross-method support/rank combinations, CellChat cached rows honor requested significance threshold, LIANA resources remain separate export, unified retrieval preserves backend labels. RunCCC(skip_failed = TRUE) now records preflight failures without aborting otherwise runnable methods. RunGSVA(): Removed redundant dense .matrix() conversion single-cell mode backend = "r"; sparse expression matrices now stay sparse row filtering, reducing peak memory avoiding unnecessary dense materialization. RunCellQC(): Replaced Seurat::SplitObject() lazy cell-name-based subsetting, avoiding full-object duplication per split group. Added caching GetAssay() gene names, GetAssayData5() counts, per-cell QC metrics (nCount / nFeature) outside species-check loop eliminate repeated data extraction. RunDEtest(): Pre-computed cell index mapping (split(names(cell_group), cell_group)) paired-marker tests, replacing per-pair () calls O(1) list lookups. AnnotateFeatures(): Replaced per-detail sapply(… "[") type-stable vapply(…, character(1)) avoid implicit list--character coercion. run_scomm(): Deferred dense conversion reference query subsetting removing premature .matrix() calls; sparse matrices subset first, densified required. RunUMAP2(): Replaced isSymmetric(.matrix(graph)) sparse-aware Matrix::isSymmetric(graph) symmetry checks graph subset sampling, avoiding dense materialization large neighbor graphs. RunUMAP2(): Replaced apply(.matrix(graph), 2, order) uwot-predict path thisutils::run_sparse_topk_stored(= "col"), avoiding full dense conversion column-wise R-level apply() retaining graph-edge semantics. RunDimsReduction() (PCA centering): Uses SeuratObject::LayerData(…, features = features) read HVF rows scale.data instead loading full matrix followed manual subsetting. RunMDS(): Removed .matrix() Matrix::t(); proxyC::dist now receives sparse matrix directly, avoiding dense conversion large count matrices. integration.R (fastMNN): Removed three .matrix() calls passed batchelor::fastMNN(), accepts sparse matrices directly via SingleCellExperiment. RunStandardWorkflow(): Replaced full scale.data matrix load (via GetAssayData5()) direct layer access (SeuratObject::GetAssayData Assay5; @scale.data Assay) retrieve rownames checking whether HVFs scaled, substantially reducing peak memory ScaleData decision step. GetAssayData5.Assay(): Fixed parameter naming use positional matching slot/layer argument, GetAssayData5() correctly retrieves counts, data, scale.data layers Seurat v4 (slot) v5 (layer). Previously named layer argument silently dropped SeuratObject v4, always returning data slot regardless requested layer. CSS_integrate(): Added Assay5 guard SeuratObject::JoinLayers() avoid errors Seurat v4 Assay objects, support layered storage. RunDimsReduction(): Added Seurat v4 fallback PCA centering — SeuratObject::LayerData(…, features = …) Assay5-; v4 Assay objects now use GetAssayData5() manual feature subsetting. RunIntegration(): Added early detection v5-integration methods (CCA, RPCA, fastMNN5, Harmony5, scVI5) provide clear, actionable error message used Seurat v4 Assay objects, rather failing deep call stack. Added loom_to_srt() pure-R loom--Seurat conversion via rhdf5, preserving velocity spliced unspliced layers assays without initializing Python, added Python-backed loom_to_adata() users need AnnData output. Added RunBulk() unified bulk-strategy entrypoint method-vector selection bulk DE, deconvolution, cell-type-specific DE workflows. Added method-specific bulk runners de_limma_voom, de_edgeR_qlf, de_DESeq2, de_dream, deconv_MuSiC, deconv_BisqueRNA, deconv_BayesPrism, csde_TOAST. Standardized bulk results Bulk$results$de, Bulk$results$deconv, Bulk$results$csde, keeping DE outputs compatible existing DEtestPlot(), RunEnrichment(), RunGSEA(), GroupHeatmap(), FeatureHeatmap() data flows. RunBulk(run_enrichment = TRUE, run_gsea = TRUE) now filters bulk DE rows pathway thresholds mirrors successful pathway results Enrichment_Bulk_wilcox GSEA_Bulk_wilcox, EnrichmentPlot() GSEAPlot() can read standard srt@tools contract. Deconvolution CSDE bundles now record computational engine details; current deconvolution runners use explicit backend = "internal" SCOP profile fitting csde_TOAST uses explicit backend = "limma_interaction", package backends can wired later without pretending call external packages. Added explicit Remotes entries mengxu98/thisplot mengxu98/thisutils source installs can resolve minimum imported versions required SCOP. Optional bulk engines DESeq2 variancePartition installed demand check_r() called lazily get_namespace_fun(). Added method_args expose method-specific tuning parameters without expanding public API surface.

title: scop 0.8.8
text: Updated minimum dependency versions thisplot (>= 0.3.8) thisutils (>= 0.4.5), removed local copies helpers now provided upstream (thisplot::annotate_quadrants(), thisplot::clip_symmetric_range(), thisutils::collapse_sparse_rows()). Updated pkgdown reference grouping cell-cycle workflow. Added optional wrappers RunDorothea(), RunBayesSpace(), experimental RunscTenifoldKnk(). RunscTenifoldKnk() keeps upstream scTenifoldNet workflow fixes QC gene-filter assignment local path, uses equivalent covariance/downdate path direct sparse matrix construction, selection-based quantile thresholding, controlled per-gene eigensolver parallelism large pcNet() network construction, uses C++ helpers tensor decomposition, manifold matrix construction, directionality, differential-regulation distance calculations. C++ tensor-decomposition path now computes MTTKRP updates directly instead materializing four dense unfolding matrices. PrepareEnv(): Added explicit support mamba micromamba executables addition conda, including command-name resolution, automatic package-managed micromamba download conda = "micromamba" requested command PATH, manager-aware logging, micromamba env path detection, ToS handling runs standard conda. Package-managed micromamba environments now use -space cache root avoid micromamba run -p path parsing failures. PrepareEnv() now also stops early reticulate already initialized different Python executable, avoiding unsafe -session switches conda micromamba. Python stack now also pins setuptools < 81 legacy packages trimap can still import pkg_resources. PrepareEnv(): default modules = NULL environment longer includes scomm; install explicitly modules = "scomm" TensorFlow/scOMM stack conflicts default JAX/scVI stack incompatible ml-dtypes requirements. CheckDataList() / RunStandardWorkflow(): Removed unnecessary -feature ScaleData() call immediately LogNormalize. Downstream workflows still scale selected HVFs PCA, large raw-count inputs longer create dense -gene scale.data intermediate checking. srt_reorder(): Replaced per-cluster repeated sparse subsetting rowMeans() single sparse group-membership matrix multiplication, speeding cluster-reordering step used RunStandardWorkflow() preserving average expression values. FindExpressedMarkers(): Added sparse fold-change detection-rate prefilter path common sparse RNA inputs, avoiding dense -feature expression materialization marker filtering preserving default results. Supplied features now intersected active layer dense fallback scoring, also keeps scale.data partial-feature layers passing absent rows fold-change calculation. C++-accelerated backends now default available: RunMetabolism(), RunGSVA(), CellScoring(), RunDynamicEnrichment(), RunEnrichment() now prefer backend = "cpp" retaining backend = "r" exact legacy/package behavior. RunPermutation() now uses validated C++ implementation directly. RunMetabolism() RunGSVA(): Added reusable C++ gene-set scoring backend ssGSEA, zscore, plage; RunGSVA() can now use backend = "cpp" method = "ssgsea", method = "zscore", method = "plage", Gaussian- Poisson-kernel method = "gsva". PLAGE scores oriented gene set mean z-score avoid backend-dependent sign flips. RunMetabolism() RunGSVA(): Added cpp_chunk_size C++ GSVA kernel paths reduce peak dense intermediate memory large cell counts; NULL now auto-selects chunk size large matrices. RunEnrichment(): Added experimental backend = "cpp" ORA path using C++ hypergeometric implementation faster enrichment tables keeping backend = "r" available clusterProfiler-compatible path. CellScoring(): Added experimental backend = "cpp" support Seurat module scoring keeping control-gene sampling R moving sparse mean calculations C++ code. RunPermutation(): Uses C++ permutation bootstrap loops directly validating match legacy R calculation observed fractions log2 fold-differences running substantially faster. RunUMAP2(): Added internal C++ sparse column top-k helper Graph inputs speed extraction precomputed neighbor indices/connectivities calling uwot. RunKNNMap() RunKNNPredict(): Added internal C++ dense column top-k helper raw KNN fallback speed nearest-neighbor extraction precomputed distance matrices. PseudotimeProjectionPlot(): Reused internal dense top-k helper pseudotime KNN/gradient neighbor extraction distance matrices. Mapping/integration metrics: Added internal C++ contingency-table helper metric_accuracy(), metric_macro_f1(), metric_purity(), metric_nmi(), metric_ari(), metric_weighted_recall(), collect_mapping_metrics(). RunMetabolism(): Added C++ backend method = "GSVA" keeps Poisson-kernel GSVA scoring path accelerates repeated count-kernel calculations. RunMetabolism() CellScoring(): Added experimental C++ backend AUCell scoring selected backend = "cpp", keeping original R/AUCell implementation available via backend = "r" exact package output. RunDynamicEnrichment() now passes backend AUCell-based scoring. CellScoring(method = "AUCell"): Fixed score-name assignment one feature list scored, avoiding vector dropping metadata column names applied. RunMetabolism(method = "VISION"): Fixed signature construction -memory gene sets passed VISION::Signature objects instead interpreted file paths. DynamicHeatmap() / custom enrichment workflows: Fixed incorrect term label display user-provided TERM2GENE / TERM2NAME use non-standard column names term / name. Custom term annotations now normalized consistently heatmap term labels show readable term names instead fallback IDs (e.g. GO IDs). Related issue #160 (@Pineapple-wen6, @mengxu98). Refactored repeated custom database input handling introducing shared internal helpers normalizing assembling user-provided TERM2GENE / TERM2NAME, applied across RunEnrichment(), RunDynamicEnrichment(), RunGSEA(), RunGSVA(), PrepareDB() keep behavior consistent.
